text: …　けいひん　こうかんじょ
note: A separate prize exchange next to the gaming hall mirrors Japanese pachinko parlours, where winnings are traded for prizes and the prizes are then swapped for cash at a separate 景品交換所 nearby.
claim: Japanese pachinko parlours have separate prize exchange places (景品交換所) nearby where prizes won are swapped for cash.

check.quote: Under Japanese law, cash cannot be paid out directly for pachinko balls, but there is usually a small establishment located nearby, separate from the game parlor but sometimes in a separate unit as part of the same building, where players may sell special prizes for cash.
